01163.name: Rotting Remains
01163.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror.

01164.name: Frozen in Fear
01164.text: Revelation - Put Frozen in Fear into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (move, fight, or evade) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Frozen in Fear.

01165.name: Dissonant Voices
01165.text: Revelation - Put Dissonant Voices into play in your threat area. You cannot play assets or events. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dissonant Voices.

01166.name: Ancient Evils
01166.text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

03043.name: Curtain Call
03043.text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 3 or more horror on you). [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -4. If your location has at least 1 horror on it, take 1 horror (from the token pool). If your location has no horror on it, place 1 horror on it instead.
03043.backText: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X, where X is the amount of horror on you. (If you have no horror on you, X is 1.) [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -5. If your location has at least 1 horror on it, take 1 horror (from the token pool). If your location has no horror on it, place 1 horror on it instead.

03044.name: The Third Act
03044.backText: Search all set-aside cards and the victory display for the Royal Emissary enemy, and spawn it in the Theatre.

03045.name: Encore
03045.text: Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Remove all doom from play and reset the agenda deck to agenda 1a. Then, place 3 doom on that agenda.
03045.backText: Each investigator takes 100 horror (cannot be prevented).

03046.name: Awakening
03046.backText: Choose one of the set-aside locations, at random. Put that location into play, and spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at that location (instead of his normal spawn location). Advance to one of the 3 copies of act 2a, at random. Remove the other 2 copies of act 2a from the game without looking at them.

03047a.name: The Stranger
03047a.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
03047a.backText: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [cultist] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the Theatre. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents spreading flames, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you enter this location or end your turn at this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.

03047b.name: The Stranger
03047b.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
03047b.backText: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [tablet] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the location The Man in the Pallid Mask was moved from. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents the advancing ooze, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you leave this location: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage." Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.

03047c.name: The Stranger
03047c.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
03047c.backText: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [elder_thing] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on each [[Private]] location. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents flooding water, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - When you would leave this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage and cancel the effects of the move. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.

03048.name: Curtain Call
03048.text: While The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, the Lobby gains: "[action]: Resign." Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 horror on each location with no horror that is connected to a location with horror. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
03048.backText: The investigators must decide (choose one): - We have to warn the police about what's going on! (→R1) - The police won't believe us. We have to solve this mystery on our own. (→R2)

03050.name: Lobby
03050.text: Forced - When Lobby is revealed: Put 2 of the set-aside Lobby Doorway locations into play, at random. [action] [action]: Draw 3 cards.

03051.name: Balcony
03051.text: Forced - After you perform a move action during which you move from the Balcony to the Theatre: Take 2 damage.

03052.name: Backstage
03052.text: Forced - When Backstage is revealed: Put 2 of the set-aside Backstage Doorway locations into play, at random. While you are at Backstage, each hidden treachery in your hand counts as 3 cards instead of 1 for the purposes of counting your hand size.

03053.name: Lighting Box
03053.text: While you are in the Lighting Box, increase the resource cost of each card in your hand by 2.

03054.name: Box Office
03054.text: [action]: Gain 5 resources. Remember that you "stole from the box office." (Group limit once per game.)

03055.name: Green Room
03055.text: [action] Investigate. You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. After this skill test ends, discard each card in your hand.

03057.name: Rehearsal Room
03057.text: Forced - After you succeed by 2 or more while investigating the Rehearsal Room: Take 1 horror.

03058.name: Trap Room
03058.text: Forced - After you reveal the Trap Room: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Swarm of Rats and put it into play engaged with you (2 copies instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Shuffle the encounter deck if it is searched.

03060.name: Royal Emissary
03060.text: Prey - Lowest [willpower]. Massive. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator at Royal Emissary's location or a connecting location takes 1 horror.

03061.name: The Last King
03061.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on a [[Lunatic]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location.
03061.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on the [[Lunatic]] enemy in play with the most remaining health.
[cultist]: -3. Place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. Take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, take 1 damage.

03062.name: Fashionably Late
03062.backText:
Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it. Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine enemy at that asset's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.

03063.name: The Terrifying Truth
03063.text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and randomly resolve one of the Sickening Reality cards underneath the scenario reference card. If there are no cards underneath the scenario reference card, advance to agenda 2b instead.

03064.name: Discovering the Truth
03064.text: Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this act, instead of placing them at his or her location. Objective - Find as many clues as you can, then get out of this awful place!
03064.backText: Madness. noun. mad.ness. The state of being mentally ill, especially severely. - Extremely foolish behavior. - A state of frenzied or chaotic activity. - Why are you looking at this side? - There is no reason to flip to Act 1b. - Flip back to Act 1a.

03065.name: Sickening Reality
03065.text:
Each investigator at Constance Dumaine's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Constance Dumaine to her location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Constance Dumaine, removing that version from the game.

03065b.name: Constance Dumaine
03065b.text:
Hunter.
While Constance Dumaine is exhausted, she gets +3 fight.

03066.name: Sickening Reality
03066.text:
Each investigator at Jordan Perry's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Jordan Perry to his location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Jordan Perry, removing that version from the game.

03066b.name: Jordan Perry
03066b.text: Hunter. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: Heal 1 damage from Jordan Perry.

03067.name: Sickening Reality
03067.text:
Each investigator at Ishimaru Haruko's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Ishimaru Haruko to her location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Ishimaru Haruko, removing that version from the game.

03067b.name: Ishimaru Haruko
03067b.text: Hunter. Forced - After you deal damage to Ishimaru Haruko by an effect other than an attack: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.

03068.name: Sickening Reality
03068.text:
Each investigator at Sebastien Moreau's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Sebastien Moreau to his location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Sebastien Moreau, removing that version from the game.

03068b.name: Sebastien Moreau
03068b.text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Sebastien Moreau's attacks cannot be canceled.

03069.name: Sickening Reality
03069.text:
Each investigator at Ashleigh Clarke's location takes 1 horror.
Move each clue from Ashleigh Clarke to her location.
Flip this card to its enemy side, and switch it with the [[Bystander]] asset version of Ashleigh Clarke, removing that version from the game

03069b.name: Ashleigh Clarke
03069b.text:
Hunter.
Each investigator at Ashleigh Clarke's location does not draw cards during the upkeep phase.

03070.name: Foyer
03070.text: [action]: Resign. Having found valuable information about the production, you depart and plan your next move. (If each undefeated investigator has resigned, proceed to "if no resolution was reached" in the Campaign Guide.)

03071.name: Ballroom
03071.text: [reaction] After you perform a parley action in the Ballroom: Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per phase.)

03072.name: Living Room
03072.text: [reaction] After you perform a parley action in the Living Room: Draw 1 card. (Group limit once per phase.)

03073.name: Gallery
03073.text: Forced - After you end your turn at the Gallery: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, place 1 of your clues on the Gallery.

03074.name: Courtyard
03074.text: Forced - After you enter the Courtyard: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, draw it.

03075.name: Dining Room
03075.text: [action]: Heal 1 horror. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed, take 1 horror and place 1 doom on the Dining Room.

03076a.name: Constance Dumaine
03076a.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to ask Constance about the play. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Constance Dumaine. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Constance Dumaine: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

03076b.name: Engram's Oath
03076b.text:
Remember that you "interviewed Constance."
Flip this card back over to its [[Bystander]] asset side.

03077.name: Jordan Perry
03077.text: [action] If you have 10 or more resources: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to fraternize with Jordan. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Jordan Perry. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Jordan Perry: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

03077b.name: L'agneau Perdu
03077b.text:
Remember that you "interviewed Jordan."
Flip this card back over to its [[Bystander]] asset side.

03078.name: Ishimaru Haruko
03078.text: [action] If you have 6 or more cards in your hand: Parley. Test [willpower] (2) to question Haruko about the play. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Ishimaru Haruko. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Ishimaru Haruko: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

03078b.name: The Pattern
03078b.text:
Remember that you "interviewed Haruko."
Flip this card back over to its [[Bystander]] asset side.

03079.name: Sebastien Moreau
03079.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to get information about the production from Sebastien. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Sebastien Moreau. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Sebastien Moreau: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

03079b.name: The First Show
03079b.text:
Remember that you "interviewed Sebastien."
Flip this card back over to its [[Bystander]] asset side.

03080.name: Ashleigh Clarke
03080.text: [action] [action]: Parley. You listen to Ashleigh perform. Take control of 1 of the clues on Ashleigh Clarke. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Ashleigh Clarke: Flip this card over and resolve its text.

03080b.name: Above and Below
03080b.text:
Remember that you "interviewed Ashleigh."
Flip this card back over to its [[Bystander]] asset side.

03081.name: Dianne Devine
03081.text: Aloof. Each investigator at Dianne Devine's location cannot discover or take control of clues. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it. Move Dianne Devine to that asset's location, if able.

03082.name: Fine Dining
03082.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either place 1 of your clues on a [[Bystander]] asset in play or take 1 horror and 1 damage.

03083.name: Tough Crowd
03083.text: Revelation - Put Tough Crowd into play next to the agenda deck. Each investigator must spend 1 additional action to parley. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Tough Crowd.

03084a.name: Whispers in Your Head
03084a.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Dismay) to your hand. You cannot commit skill cards to skill tests. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Dismay) from your hand.

03084b.name: Whispers in Your Head
03084b.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Dread) to your hand. You cannot move more than once each turn. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Dread) from your hand.

03084c.name: Whispers in Your Head
03084c.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Anxiety) to your hand. You cannot trigger [fast] abilities. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Anxiety) from your hand.

03084d.name: Whispers in Your Head
03084d.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Doubt) to your hand. You cannot play events. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Doubt) from your hand.

03085.name: Descent into Madness
03085.text: Surge. Revelation - If you have at least 3 horror on you, lose 1 action.

03090.name: Black Stars Rise
03090.text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda or take 1 horror for each point you failed by. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.

03091.name: Spires of Carcosa
03091.text: Revelation - Attach to your location, then place 2 doom on that location. If there is no doom on attached location, discard Spires of Carcosa. [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues here, remove 1 doom from attached location.

03092.name: Twisted to His Will
03092.text: Revelation - If there is no doom in play, Twisted to His Will gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (X), where X is the amount of doom in play. If you fail, discard 2 cards from your hand at random.

03093.name: Poltergeist
03093.text: Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], or encounter cards. [action] Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to attempt to banish the geist. If you succeed, deal it 1 damage.

03094.name: Spirit's Torment
03094.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you leave attached location: You must either take 1 horror or lose 1 action. [action] Place 1 of your clues on attached location: Discard Spirit's Torment.

03095.name: Maniac
03095.text: Forced - After Maniac engages you: Take 1 damage and deal 1 damage to Maniac.

03096.name: Young Psychopath
03096.text: Forced - After Young Psychopath engages you: You must either take 1 horror, or Young Psychopath gets +3 fight until the end of the investigation phase.

03097.name: Dance of the Yellow King
03097.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Lunatic]] enemies in play, Dance of the Yellow King gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, the nearest [[Lunatic]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.

03098.name: Fanatic
03098.text: Spawn - Revealed location with the most clues. Forced - After Fanatic enters play: Move 1 clue from Fanatic's location to Fanatic. Forced - When you defeat Fanatic: Take control of all of its clues.

03099.name: Agent of the King
03099.text: Prey - Most clues. Hunter. Forced - After Agent of the King attacks you: Move 1 of your clues to Agent of the King. Forced - When you defeat Agent of the King: Take control of all of its clues.

03100.name: The King's Edict
03100.text: Revelation - For each [[Cultist]] enemy in play, move 1 clue from that enemy's location to that enemy. Until the end of the round, each [[Cultist]] enemy in play gets +1 fight for each clue and/or doom on it. If no clues are moved by this effect, The King's Edict gains surge.

03101.name: Ooze and Filth
03101.text: Revelation - Put Ooze and Filth into play next to the act deck. Each location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Ooze and Filth.

03102.name: Corrosion
03102.text: Revelation - Discard [[Item]] assets from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the shroud value of your location. If no cards are discarded by this effect, Corrosion gains surge.

03103.name: Roach Swarm
03103.text: X is the shroud value of Roach Swarm's location.

03104.name: Marked by the Sign
03104.text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 2 horror. If The Man in the Pallid Mask is in play, horror dealt by this effect is considered direct horror, and this test has +2 difficulty.

03105.name: The Pale Mask Beckons
03105.text: Revelation - If The Man in the Pallid Mask is in play, he attacks each investigator in player order, regardless of his current location. If The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, search his bearer's deck and discard pile for him, draw him, and shuffle his bearer's deck (resolve this effect even if his bearer is currently eliminated, searching all out-of-play areas).
